zeely.upside: All three co-founders made Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe on $1.3M raised — strong founder validation. Company self-reports 650k+ sellers across 2,000+ industries, AI trained on $100M+ of ad spend. 2023 monthly revenue at $50k+ growing 150%/quarter.
zeely.risk: ARR figure hasn't been updated since the 2023 $3M target. Hybrid pricing ($29–$90/mo subscription + 12% take rate on Meta ad spend) puts Zeely closer to martech-services than pure SaaS. Billing complaints persistent: BBB filings, TikTok #zeelyscam, JustUseApp 66.7/100.
